status: Ten current native views promoted after completed pixel review; scoped kitchen/pantry revision, not whole-home design approval
scope: Coordinated kitchen, pantry, nearby furnishings, ceiling, lighting and local glazing revision with all ten native views refreshed. AI photographic studies are separate derivatives registered in gallery.json and do not count as native render evidence.
receipt_method: Current file hashes and PNG dimensions checked against the actual promoted files and their matching render candidates. Render settings and source hashes consolidated from completed renderer records. Completed pixel review is recorded in design-review.md; this receipt refresh does not assert a new render or native reopen.

review_notes.01-exterior: Paired timber wings, dark pitched roofs, central glazed gable and arrival approach retained after the coordinated interior revision.
review_notes.02-elevated: Elevated view shows roof intersections and courtyard relationship; exterior-led massing retained.
review_notes.03-garden-entry: Garden threshold, entry canopy and planted courtyard remain the dedicated signature-feature view.
review_notes.04-model-plan: Reviewed roof-off arrangement includes revised kitchen island, cooking/cleanup walls, fitted pantry and supported adjacent furnishings. The separate dimensioned plan remains the readable plan deliverable.
review_notes.05-living-dining: View from the living room through courtyard glazing; this camera primarily explains the indoor/courtyard relationship. The new 10-living-room view shows the furnished room.
review_notes.06-kitchen: Real modeled sink/dishwasher, drawer and waste storage, integrated refrigeration, island and three stools replace placeholders; work aisles and pantry access have separate measured evidence.
review_notes.07-rear-garden: Rear elevation includes counter-height kitchen glazing and solid cedar spandrel beside living-room full-height glass; existing foreground tree and shrub positions retained.
review_notes.08-cooking-wall: 36-inch induction cooktop, separate 30-inch oven, 36-inch hood/chimney, smoked-oak drawers and integrated refrigerator are visible. Sage tile is concentrated on the cooking wall.
review_notes.09-pantry: Six shared shelving bays, rear drawer bases/worktop, power outlet, high side glazing and usable clear aisle are visible.
review_notes.10-living-room: Shared linen sofa, supported oak coffee table and adjacent dining furniture are grounded beneath the finished timber ceiling.

current_limitations: Whole-home bedroom storage, premium bathroom fitout, laundry/services and parking/site arrangement remain unresolved.
Selected commercial appliance installation, ventilation, utilities, roof drainage, assemblies, structure and approvals remain unverified.
The generic refrigerator sweep allowance retains an explicit selected-product coordination note in model/kitchen-validation.json.
Some legacy bedroom/bathroom, planting and paving geometry still awaits shared-library migration.
